# AgriSaarthi Test Fixture Document

This is a verified test document for pipeline execution testing. It does not contain real agricultural data to prevent hallucination in the RAG pipeline.

## Soil Section
The ideal soil test type for the test-crop is test-soil. It requires a pH of exactly 7.99 for optimal testing growth.

## Pest Section
The major pest for the test-crop is the test-bug. It appears during the testing phase of the crop lifecycle.
Do not use real chemicals. Use 500ml of Test-Chemical per hectare.

## Guidelines
This document is strictly for testing the ingestion pipeline, metadata preservation, and chunking boundaries.
